anchors.functionality: 8: Works. At most 2 major issues, each with a known fix under 1 hour of CAD and no reprint of a big part (one major: A2-01, thick-candy full-lift gap)
anchors.manufacturability: 8: 9 not met (BOM errors change the assembly: nip stud length, non-stock M3 x 9, missing encoder lead); 0 fastener fails, all warns explained, no supports, P1S fit
anchors.aesthetics: 8: each failed item costs a point from 10; 2 failed (detent clip edge break 0.3 vs EB 1.0; detent pan head proud, not counterbored)

issues.problem: Min-gap stop sized for the nominal 7.0 candy (NIP_PASS = MM_T_NOM + TAPE_T) although params declare MM_T up to 7.5: a 7.5 candy is rigidly squeezed 0.07-0.39 mm with the leaf solid over hood +0.327..-0.07 (settings 6.2..~6.57, 46% of the window); a nominal candy uses 1.38 of 1.5 mm leaf travel at the min stop. Window 6.2..7.0 is also far narrower than the rig's 5..12 thumbwheel range.
issues.evidence: review/cadcheck_review.json distances: PRT_hood-PRT_flywheel along PIV_hood ray y34 at nip_lift -1.493 = 7.613 (hood 0.327) FAIL, 7.928 (0) FAIL, 8.12 (-0.2), 8.461 (-0.558), wanted >= 8.0; params.py line 393 NIP_PASS = MM_T_NOM + TAPE_T
issues.fix: Assert HOOD_GAP_LIFT >= MM_T[1] + TAPE_T and adopt the review row (min 8.0). Caliper 20 candies; if MM_T max > 7.1 raise the nip cover roof 0.5 along the stud axis (LEAF_TRAVEL 1.5 -> 2.0, full-lift gap ~8.08 at the min stop), relieve the body bay 0.5 at hood -2.6 deg effective, re-run the leaf flexures row (~36 MPa; LEAF_T 2.5 -> 2.3 to bring it near 31).

issues.problem: The encoder signal has no purchased lead from the journal bore to the MotorGo: CAB_encoder (150 mm) ends at the left journal; the ~430 mm on through the bundle and base lead is only 16 AWG phase wire in the BOM, sharing a sleeve with the BLDC phases. CAB_bus_pan has only 9.5 mm spare.
issues.evidence: checks.cables: CAB_encoder 84.1/150 (route ends at IF_JOURNAL_L_X1+0.5, parts/launcher.py:589), CAB_launcher_bundle 265.4/350, CAB_launcher_base 164.8/250, CAB_bus_pan 290.5/300; BOM items 13 and 15
issues.fix: Add a BOM row for a one-piece 5-wire encoder lead >= 550 mm (Plink to MotorGo encoder JST, no splice at either joint), model CAB_encoder as one route with lead_len 550, use twisted/shielded wire on the far side of the sleeve from the phases; list a 350 mm bus lead for the pan servo.

issues.problem: Pocket Ø13.9 blocks the min-size (12.5 x 6.3) edge-on pair by only 0.016 mm3 (the cad q dist reporting floor is 0.01), i.e. ~0.05 radial; nominal and leaning pairs are blocked well, and the flat 13.5 candy has 0.198 radial. Both edges of the window depend on print shrink and real candy spread.
issues.evidence: cad q dist ZMM_a PRT_feeder_disc on /tmp/rv3probe/mm_12.5x6.3_t00.blend = -0.016; t10 -0.095, t20 -1.28, t30 -16.9; mm_13.0x7.0_t00 -6.134; designer lentil probe flat 13.5x7.5 +0.198
issues.fix: Caliper 20 candies and set MM_D/MM_T min/max; print a 3-pocket coupon disc Ø13.7/13.9/14.1, pick the pocket that passes the flat max and blocks a min pair, set POCKET_D and keep the 4 ray rows at +/-0.1.

issues.problem: PRT_gate_detent uses EB 0.3 on the whole clip including its 2.6-6 mm tab (declared EB 1.0 +/-0.5), its square 1.2 plate stands ~14 mm proud of the R34 valve OD and reads as a stray grey plate in iso.png (snag point beside the gate tab), FST_detent_0 is a proud pan head (head='none'), and M3 x 9 is not a stock length.
issues.evidence: params.py GATE_DETENT edge 0.3, plate_x/plate_y corner at r 48; parts/feeder.py:113 head='none'; renders/attempt-3/review/r01_valve_gate_detent_closeup_+x+y.png, r02_valve_gate_closeup_+x-y.png; renders/attempt-3/iso.png
issues.fix: Bevel the tab EB 1.0 and the plate 0.6, round the plate's free end R3 in plan; counterbore the head Ø6.5 x 1.0 into the tab (clamp 3.2 -> 2.2) and use a stock M3 x 10 pan self-tap (tip lands where the x 9 tip is now, 2.65 above the blade); optionally colour B as a gate touch point.

issues.problem: BOM fastener table lists FST_nip_stud as 'M3 x 20 hex head' but the model and params use STUD_L 16 (tip 2.4 under the cover roof at full lift on the 7.0 setting); an x 20 stud sits 4 mm further out. The model also uses a cap-head spec in the hex pocket, so the head key is never measured.
issues.evidence: manifest.json FST_nip_stud part 'M3_cap x 16', length 16.0; params.py STUD_L = 16.0; BOM section 2 row 'M3 x 20 hex head (stud)'
issues.fix: Change the BOM row to 'M3 x 16 hex head, ISO 4017' and give FST_nip_stud a hex-head spec (AF 5.5 x 2.0) so the pocket fit is checked.

issues.problem: The BOM 'Base floor' service has a service row but no slide_out row; the full-lift gap row asserts the nominal 7.5 rather than the declared max; the detent's open-notch claim has no row (gate is not a joint).
issues.evidence: checks.json service 'base floor off' (no slide_out); review/cadcheck_review.json slide 'base floor plate ... -Z' not blocked; gate probe /tmp/rv3probe/gate_+52.00.blend PRT_gate_detent-PRT_jar_gate 0.10
issues.fix: Adopt review/review_rows.json as is (floor slide -Z 40, full-lift min 8.0 at 4 hood settings, 7.5-payload drop); add a prismatic PIV_gate 0..52.35 if the tool supports it and make the detent a distances row at both ends.
